subject: Invoice delivery: choosing portal vs. email + PO mapping
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthgrid.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery options & PO mapping for HealthGrid

Hi Connor,

Hope you're well — we're getting the AP flow ready for Redwood and wanted to confirm how invoices will be sent to HealthGrid and how PO numbers should appear. A few quick items: 

- Preferred delivery channel: portal (preferred) or direct email PDF?
- If portal, do you send PDF copies to an AP inbox too?
- For our ERP mapping we need a consistent tag/field for the PO number in the invoice XML (we prefer a "PO_NUMBER" element). Can you share a sample XML or schema?
- VAT: we need Redwood's VAT registration and whether you can include VAT ID on the invoice line items.

Can you loop in your billing contact and any onboarding docs? We're aiming to have the first invoices routed to our AP team for the first invoice scheduled the first week of next month.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Finance Operations
HealthGrid
elena.ruiz@healthgrid.com
+1 (415) 555-2198

--
Accounts Payable team: ap@healthgrid.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options & PO mapping for HealthGrid

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping Marissa (billing) who owns onboarding. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) Channel options
- Portal (recommended): We can publish invoices to your portal account (secure, auditable). You can optionally enable automatic PDF copies to an AP email address (you called out ap@healthgrid.com) — most customers do both for ERP intake.
- Email (fallback): We can deliver signed PDF invoices to a designated inbox.

2) PO mapping
- We support embedding a PO element in our XML export. Our canonical element is <PO_NUMBER>, but we can map to alternate tags in a one-time transform if your ERP requires something else.

3) VAT info
- We'll include Redwood's VAT/Tax ID on the invoice header and line items where applicable. Marissa will attach the VAT cert and the sample XML.

4) Timeline
- If you confirm portal onboarding, we can provision the tenant and invite your AP users within 3 business days; first invoices can be published in the following invoice run.

Attaching the onboarding checklist and the schema sample in a follow-up from Marissa. Let us know if you need SFTP or API push instead of portal.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-3301

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthgrid.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@healthgrid.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options & PO mapping for HealthGrid

Hi Elena — thanks for starting this. See details and attached artifacts.

Summary of options we support (and what we'd recommend):
- Redwood Portal (recommended): Secure portal with per-invoice metadata, immediate search, and API access. We will provide a tenant invite (email-based) and an API key if you want automated pulls.
- SFTP push: We can drop XML+PDF bundles to an SFTP endpoint (mutual TLS as an option).
- Email PDF: Send to a dedicated invoices@healthgrid.com inbox (least preferred for automation).

PO mapping details:
- Default XML element: <PO_NUMBER> — we include it at the invoice header level.
- If your ERP expects P_O or PONum, provide a sample and we'll adapt the feed (one-time mapping).

VAT / tax evidence
- Redwood will include VAT ID: GB123456789 (we'll also supply an exportable VAT certificate).

Onboarding steps (portal route)
1) Confirm primary AP contact(s) to receive tenant invites.
2) We provision tenant and send welcome + admin invite.
3) You confirm PO field mapping and optional email copies.
4) We do a short validation run (we publish a sample invoice XML/PDF to your tenant for verification).

Attachments included:
- redwood_portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf (step-by-step, includes sample roles and invite template)
- invoice_schema_v2.xml (canonical schema, shows <PO_NUMBER> placement)

If portal works, Connor will coordinate the tenant invite. If you need SFTP details instead I can share host/credentials and a sample drop folder format.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@healthgrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@healthgrid.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options & PO mapping for HealthGrid

Thanks Marissa — portal sounds ideal. Quick confirmations: 

- Please invite these contacts to the tenant: ap@healthgrid.com (shared inbox) and myself (elena.ruiz@healthgrid.com).
- We'll want an email copy to ap@healthgrid.com for the first 2 months while our ERP mapping is validated.
- PO format: we'll use prefix pattern "HG-P-" (so example HG-P-2026-00421). The PO element on our side will map to <PO_NUMBER> — that matches your default, so no transform needed.
- VAT: appreciate the VAT ID, please attach the certificate when you send the onboarding packet.

Can you schedule the tenant invite this week? We aim to have the first invoice flow on the run starting Aug 2.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — copying AP so they can confirm readiness.

Elena Ruiz
Director, Finance Operations
HealthGrid
